low_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Near-zero pile of 398 shots at ipm2c<200 (median photon_px=41 vs 8815 normal); normalization planned so threshold raised to linear-plateau start at 3000 (0.81x median 3695); 1781 of 3177 xray-on shots kept.

high_ipm_exclusion.rationale: det_total/ipm2c ratio flat across deciles (20.5–22.0); top-1% ratio 23.6 within scatter of bulk (std 12.7); no droop or gain switching evidence — cutting discards highest-SNR frames for no benefit.

normalization.rationale: Chrono-bin CV 9.33%->3.42% with normalization; det~ipm2c r=0.895; per-shot division safe because low-ipm cut at 3000 ensures all kept shots on linear plateau.
